steps.path: Header over Meadow Mist and Midnight
steps.headline: No black button override or pale rings around the dots.
steps.changed: Buttons have their previous theme colors back, with a subtle same-color halo. Status dots keep their green, red, amber, blue or gray centers and get a faint same-color glow instead of a white outline. The selected session keeps the increased transparency, but its text returns to the theme's original softer shade.
steps.notice: Only float-style cushion chrome is affected. No full-width veil or new button fill; other styles and content surfaces are unchanged.
